usageNotes: Use this to pull systemd journal (syslog) entries from a PDM node for diagnostics, auditing, or log review. The caller must hold the System.Audit privilege on the system/log ACL path. Pagination is cursor-based — use startcursor/endcursor from a prior response to page forward/backward; do not mix cursor and epoch parameters as they conflict.

examples.summary: Retrieve the last 100 journal lines from a node

tips: startcursor and since are mutually exclusive — use one or the other, not both.
endcursor and until are mutually exclusive — same constraint applies.
Omitting all params returns the full journal, which can be very large on busy nodes; always scope with lastentries or a since/until epoch window.
Use 'localhost' as the node value when the API request is already targeting the local node's address.
Entries are returned as raw syslog-formatted strings; parse with standard journal tools if structured fields are needed.
